fields.logoUrlHint: Public URL for the logo. Leave empty to use the default Pensa Club logo.
fields.signatureHint: Multi-line signature. The first line is plain, following lines use the primary color as accent.
fields.headerHtmlHint: Optional — HTML block under the logo, before the email body.
fields.footerHtmlHint: Optional — HTML block above the unsubscribe link.

actions.resetAllHint: Clears all saved overrides and restores the original Pensa Club template
actions.resetConfirmBody: This will delete ALL stored overrides (logo, colors, signature, header/footer HTML) and restore the original Pensa Club template. This cannot be undone.

preview.title: Preview
preview.sampleBody: This is sample text. Links and accents use the primary color.

messages.saved: Template saved. Future emails will use the new settings.
messages.invalidColor: Invalid color for "{{field}}" — must be hex (e.g. #E26020).
